attractions heinz history center-western pennsylvania sports museum the western pennsylvania sports museum, a state-of-the-art museum at the senator john heinz history center, features a stunning collection of one-of-a-kind sports artifacts and interactive exhibits that celebrate the rich tradition of sports in our region. when it comes to sports pride and sports history, no other region in the world is like western pennsylvania. engine house no.25 this historic firehouse now holds some of the most fascinating memorabilia of roberto clemente. schedule a tour to see the paintings,
